_comment_urls: External destinations. The /contact link on Bridges to Healing is reserved for the therapy funnel CTA only; general mentions use practiceUrl.
_comment_audio: REPLACE ME — the Cloudflare R2 public bucket URL for `mayanas-professional-site`. Set this ONE value and every meditation becomes playable. Leave it as an empty string and the player shows an honest 'audio coming soon' state instead of 404ing. Format: https://pub-xxxxxxxx.r2.dev  (or a custom domain such as https://audio.mayanageathers.com). No trailing slash.
_comment_images: Photography slots. A value may be a bare FILENAME (looked up in src/assets/img/, and skipped if not present yet) or a FULL URL (e.g. an R2 public URL), which is used as-is. That lets large photography live in the bucket alongside the audio instead of in git.
